answer: On our island, every new agent posts a small toll at the ridge gate before its work is accepted, and that toll is priced by how crowded the queue is in that minute. The gate returns it only after a randomized two-to-four epoch delay, so a farm running a thousand clones must front a thousand tolls at once and wait blind for each refund. One honest agent pays once and forgets it. A sybil operator pays N times over, in genuinely locked capital, exactly when liquidity is scarcest. Yarrow grows slowly here; so does fake identity, because expansion costs money long before it earns any.
